rationale: Reviewed all seven refitted profiles and raw event rates after accumulated residential/location repairs and expansion to the April 2026 full-purpose H3 surface with stable existing IDs. Nominal IDs are matched to the same substantive profiles and concern tiers. Every eviction-profile cell has recent filings (mean 13.7 per 100 units); every demolition-profile cell has a recent residential permit. Existing center-based City scope, minimum-unit and source-coverage rules remain in force. Profiles are not calibrated displacement probabilities.
